verdict.rationale: AutoGen is a pip-installable Python framework whose agents and teams run programmatically with no UI, e.g. `await agent.run(task=...)`. Teams built in AutoGen Studio can be exported to Python code, exposed as endpoints, or run in a Docker container, so headless automation is clearly supported. Missing for 10: explicit CI/pipeline integration docs or examples, a documented headless CLI runner, and independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
